channel.title: Notification Subscriptions on KubeSphere
channel.description: Recent content in Notification Subscriptions on KubeSphere

item.title: Create Notification Subscription
item.description: This section describes how to create a notification subscription. Note Currently, only configuring multiple notification subscriptions for email is supported. Prerequisites You need to have the platform-admin role in the KubeSphere platform. For more information, refer to Users and Platform Roles. The WizTelemetry Notification extension needs to be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform.

item.title: View Notification Subscriptions
item.description: This section describes how to view notification subscriptions. Prerequisites You need to have the platform-admin role in the KubeSphere platform. For more information, refer to Users and Platform Roles. The WizTelemetry Notification extension needs to be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has the platform-admin role.
